title: Pirate Myths
hook: Pirates almost never made anyone walk the plank.

scenes.text: The classic image of pirates with buried treasure maps and plank-walking was invented by Victorian novelists.

scenes.text: Walking the plank was virtually unheard of. If pirates wanted you dead, they shot you or marooned you on a sandbar.

scenes.text: They almost never buried treasure. Pirates spent their plunder immediately in pirate havens like Nassau and Port Royal.
